motion.text:
Motion (mygo-music × magpie)
• Panel open: fade + 8px drop from the tray icon, 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)
• Routing wire: dashes flow caller → hub → channel, 900ms linear loop, only while the selected request is in progress
• Hub halo ripples outward 1.8s while streaming
• In-progress row: 3 equalizer bars (amber)
• Running dot breathes 1.6s
• Rows slide in 220ms, staggered 30ms; selection tint 120ms
• Buttons press to 0.94 scale
• First load: skeleton shimmer 1.6s instead of “Loading…”
• Honors reduced motion
